name: Motorized Pedalcycle
description: An electric motor-driven cycle with operable pedals and an automatic transmission and a maximum design speed of 25 mph, Pennsylvania's moped. An electric bike that tops a pedalcycle with electric assist's 750 watts, 20 mph or 100 pounds but can't go faster than 25 mph lands here. Defined by Pennsylvania Consolidated Statutes Title 75 §102.
restrictions: Operable pedals, an automatic transmission, and a battery-powered electric motor; the 1.5 horsepower and 50 cc limits apply only to a combustion engine
A kind of motor-driven cycle, so its motor produces no more than 5 brake horsepower (about 3,730 W)
Riders need a Class C driver's license, so must be 16 or older
No helmet or eye protection required
Follows the rules for motor-driven cycles, so kept off sidewalks and bike lanes
One faster than 25 mph is a motor-driven cycle or a motorcycle
